articles.title_en: Three months after Ukraine began striking warehouses belonging to Russian online shopping giants Wildberries and Ozon, workers and sellers describe the damage to their livelihoods
articles.lead_en: Wildberries and Ozon play an enormous role in Russia’s economy and in the lives of millions of Russians, as well as entrepreneurs and shoppers in the Commonwealth of Independent States, where both companies also operate. For some, these online marketplaces offer relatively low prices; for others, jobs at logistics centers where pay often exceeds the regional average; and for still others, a platform to grow their own businesses.
